integrity: The lower bound is analytic; the two explicit upper bounds are complete exact-rational certificates whose 200 triangles jointly triangulate the fundamental square. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: No exact covering numbers are asserted for radii below 1/3; uniqueness of optimal configurations, arbitrary rectangular tori and other metrics are not established. Historical priority against alternative periodic diamond-covering terminology remains provisional.
title: The five-ball plateau and the missing sixth covering number of the Manhattan square torus
